chunks: From him, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Mūsā ibn Bakr, who said:
I heard him while he was saying: “There is no hadd punishment upon a coerced woman if she says: I was only compelled.”

key_terms.إِذَا: when; indicating the condition attached to the ruling
key_terms.إِنَّمَا: only; restricting the meaning of her statement
key_terms.مُسْتَكْرَهَةٍ: a woman who has been coerced or compelled

ai.seo_question: Is there a hadd punishment on a woman who was forced into zina?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the hadd punishment is not applied to a woman who was compelled. It establishes coercion as removing legal liability in the case described, when she states that she was forced.
